entries.en: Ah, I just remembered... all the time[n]we spent together.

entries.en: It's kind of nice that we can be reunited[n]like this.

entries.en: Our relationship with humans is selfish[n]by nature...

entries.en: ...So if I give you money, we can have a[n]clean break?

entries.en: Hm? Have you started to show a bit[n]more maturity?

entries.en: Well, I suppose that's true...

entries.en: What's important is... money.

entries.en: What you want are... items. So here.

entries.en: ...So you want to talk? We don't know[n]each other very well, after all.

entries.en: ...I remember you. I'd be fine talking[n]with you again, but... should we?

entries.en: It'd be nice if we had a fun time,[n]wouldn't it?

entries.en: Playing hard to get? That's just like me.[n]Wait, I remember something...

entries.en: Men... Why do they insist on telling such[n]obvious lies...?

entries.en: Gyaaah!

entries.en: ...You treat women and children this[n]way!? Geez, it looks like anything goes[n]with you...!
